text: Hey, do you have a minute? I need help with my English assignment. Sure. What’s up? I have to find three sources that support my thesis, but I can’t seem to find any that are actually relevant. What’s your thesis? It’s about how the internet is affecting the way we read and write. Okay, that shouldn’t be too hard to find sources for. Do you have any ideas? Not really. I’ve been searching online for a while and I’m just not finding anything that’s helpful. Well, maybe try looking in the library databases instead of just using a search engine. That might give you some more specific results. Yeah, that’s a good idea. Thanks! No problem! Let me know if you need any more help. Great, will do!
